summary:
## Current objective
Fix the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`, which is double-counting refunds. The earlier `tenacity` refactor of `ledgerly/sync/client.py` is paused until next sprint.

Use sandbox payments at `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Never edit `tests/conftest.py` without posting the proposed diff in `#ledgerly-tests` and waiting for `@mira` approval. Never edit `api/openapi.yaml` without posting the proposed diff in `#ledgerly-api` and tagging `@dana-api`. Do not retry increasing Celery `visibility_timeout`.

## Recent work
Invoice-PDF rendering was improved:

- Negative credit lines are no longer discarded; they render after their related invoice item.
- Amounts now use shared, locale-aware `format_money()`.
- Added `_row_height()` and corrected page-height calculations.
- Fixed continuation-page/table-height accounting and pagination.
- Added regression tests for credits, currency formatting, and an 86-item invoice.
- Exact verification:
  - `pytest tests/test_invoice_pdf.py -q` → `14 passed, 1 skipped in 2.07s`
  - `pytest tests/billing -q --disable-warnings` → `83 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed in 6.41s`
  - `ruff check ledgerly/billing/pdf.py tests/test_invoice_pdf.py` → `All checks passed!`
- Existing golden PDFs remained byte-stable. A visual comparison of three generated PDFs is still useful.
- Last inspection found legacy session factories in `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, and protected `tests/conftest.py`.

The S3 decommission copied and verified 184 objects; versioning was suspended and one versioned object was deleted. Next, inspect reconciliation refund logic and reproduce the double-counting with a focused test.

All invoice tests pass: 18 passed. Ruff and `git diff --check` pass. Modified files are `ledgerly/api/invoices.py`, `ledgerly/services/invoices.py`, `ledgerly/schemas/invoice.py`, and the new pagination test. The earlier billing idempotency fix was already committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`.
